name: AgentInspector
summary: The detail of one agent: configuration, tools, instructions.

a11y.apg: none — a labelled region, so a screen reader can jump to it

props.name: title
props.description: Names the panel, and names the region for a screen reader when it is a string.

props.name: sections
props.type: Array<{ label: string; items: Array<{ term: string; value: ReactNode }> }>
props.description: Labelled groups of term and value, each one a DataList — the anatomy of the reference's DetailsView, using the component that already exists here.

props.name: children
props.description: Free body under the sections, for inspecting what the record did not foresee.
